We need to identify SMILES of an organic sample given no data yet. We need to use tools to get spectra etc. The task likely expects us to query the sample's spectra (mass spec, NMR, IR) then deduce structure.

We have no initial data. We need to call mass_spectrometry_spectra() to get MS. Then maybe carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra. Use those to deduce.

Let's start with mass spec.
